page_title: Rockxy — Open-Source HTTP/HTTPS Debugger for macOS

sources.entry: Rockxy - Open-source HTTP(S) debugging proxy for intercepting, inspecting, modifying, and replaying requests. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/LocNguyenHuu/Rockxy) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: Rockxy
summary.one_liner: Rockxy is a local-first, open-source HTTP/HTTPS debugging proxy for macOS that captures, inspects, modifies, replays, and redacts API, mobile, WebSocket, GraphQL, AI, and Web3/RPC traffic.
use_cases: debug failing API requests from apps or CLI tools
capture iOS Simulator or Android emulator traffic
replay and compare failed vs fixed requests
share redacted HTTP captures with teammates
inspect AI model API calls and streaming output
summary.what_it_does: Rockxy captures HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, GraphQL, AI API, and Web3/JSON-RPC traffic from apps, services, CLI tools, simulators and devices into a local macOS workspace. It lets you filter sessions, inspect headers, bodies, cookies, timing and TLS details, and modify traffic with rules, breakpoints, header overrides, map local/remote and block-host rules. Requests can be reopened, edited, replayed and compared in a diff view, and evidence can be exported as HAR, cURL or JSON with authorization headers and bearer tokens redacted. It also exposes a local MCP server so AI coding tools can list, inspect, replay and compare captured flows.
notable: Open source under AGPL-3.0 with public source on GitHub and signed releases with SHA256 checksums
Local MCP server lets AI coding tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Copilot inspect and replay captured flows
Built on SwiftUI/AppKit and SwiftNIO with a privileged helper for system proxy changes
Free tier covers capture, inspection and AI-assisted debugging; Pro/Workspace tiers exist for workflows and teams
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; no Windows or Linux build is named on the page
Pinned hosts cannot be decrypted and pass through encrypted; HTTP/3 over QUIC is under review and gRPC/Protobuf decoding is planned
Guided iOS/mobile setup automation is still on the roadmap; manual proxy and certificate setup is documented today
Roadmap items and planned AI provider integrations (DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, Doubao, GLM) have no committed delivery dates
